label: OFFLINE PILOT — feasibility checks ONLY. NOT the research benchmark (benchmark-v1 is Phase 5, not started). NOT final research data.
created_by: OpenCode (Phase 4 offline pilot, authorized by user)
provenance: 100% synthetic. Names, e-mails, phone numbers, employers, universities and all resume/JD text are fictional and authored for this pilot. No real personal data, no scraped resumes, no real job postings.
purpose: Validate that the rule-based matcher and the input gates can process baseline pairs and controlled edits as the protocol assumes, using only offline, zero-network code paths.

resumes[].text: full synthetic resume text (line-oriented, ALL-CAPS section headers required by collectEvidence)

pairs[].designed_tier: High|Mid|Low (authoring intent; actual overlap computed offline by the check script)

edits[].target_skill: vocabulary skill name or null for E4
edits[].variant_resume_text: full resume text after the single change

generation_process: Hand-authored 2026-10-13 against backend constraints verified in REPOSITORY_AUDIT.md and backend source: >=50 words per field (server.js countWords), authenticity gates (llm.js collectValidationErrors/looksLikeResume), rule-arm skill vocabulary (ruleBasedFallback.js SKILL_VOCABULARY), ALL-CAPS section headers (isSectionHeader), experience lines need year ranges (collectEvidence), one change at a time per edit, E2/E1/E3 targets chosen from the JD requirement scan, E4 length-matched to E1 (+/-10% added characters) and containing no vocabulary skill.
reproducibility: Deterministic by construction: this file is the single source of truth; research/scripts/pilot_offline_check.mjs reads it, runs only buildMatchAnalysis + parseResume + scanSkills/extractJobRequirements/collectEvidence (all offline), and writes research/results/pilot/pilot_check_results.json. Re-run with: node research/scripts/pilot_offline_check.mjs. No randomness, no network, no AI matcher.

jobs.text:
Java Backend Engineer (Mid-Level)

We are hiring a Java Backend Engineer to build reliable services for our payments platform.

Role and responsibilities:
- Design and implement REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
- Write efficient SQL against PostgreSQL and tune slow queries.
- Own microservices in production with Docker-based deployments.
- Collaborate with frontend engineers through well-defined contracts.

Requirements:
- Must have 2+ years of experience with Java and Spring Boot.
- Must have experience with SQL and PostgreSQL.
- Experience with Docker and Git is required.
- Strong understanding of REST APIs and microservices.
- A bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent is preferred.

React Frontend Developer (Junior)

We are looking for a Junior React Frontend Developer to grow with our product team.

What you will do:
- Build responsive user interfaces with React and TypeScript.
- Implement accessible pages using HTML and CSS.
- Maintain a shared component library and write unit tests.
- Work closely with designers to ship small features every week.

Requirements:
- Must have working knowledge of React, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
- Experience with HTML, CSS, and Git is required.
- Familiarity with Redux is a strong plus.
- A portfolio of personal projects is required.

Machine Learning Engineer (Mid-Level)

Our data products team needs a Machine Learning Engineer to build and ship models.

Role and responsibilities:
- Develop training and evaluation pipelines in Python.
- Build models using scikit-learn and deep learning techniques.
- Analyse large datasets with Pandas and NumPy.
- Package services with Docker and collaborate on SQL data stores.

Requirements:
- Must have 2+ years of experience with Python and machine learning.
- Must have hands-on experience with Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.
- Experience with SQL and Docker is required.
- A master's degree in a quantitative field is preferred.

Senior DevOps Engineer (Senior)

We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to own our cloud platform.

What you will do:
- Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform on AWS.
- Operate Kubernetes clusters and Docker workloads at scale.
- Maintain CI/CD pipelines and Linux fleet reliability.
- Mentor engineers on incident response and system health.

Requirements:
- Must have 5+ years of experience with AWS and Linux.
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform is required.
- Must have strong CI/CD and Git skills.
- Nginx configuration experience is a plus.
